titleStmt.title: Financial Clauses: Opinion of the Drafting Committee on Certain Modifications Demanded by the Czecho-Slovak Delegation (Note of 30th May, 1919)

div.head: Financial Clauses: Opinion of the Drafting Committee on Certain Modifications Demanded by the Czecho-Slovak Delegation (Note of 30th May, 1919)

list.item: The proposed additions to the second paragraph of article 3, and to article 6 fall within the sphere of the financial Commission.

The proposed additions to the first and third paragraphs of Article 10 would be intelligible if a provision analogous to that stated in the Czecho-Slovak note as being proposed by that Delegation for insertion in the part of the Treaty relating to Reparation were inserted in the Treaty.
The proposed addition to the first paragraph would be too restrictive even if this insertion were made.
Article 15, line 5. The text prepared by the Drafting Committee reads “… interests of her nationals” (“… that Austria become possessed of any rights and interests of her nationals”.)
The proposed addition to Article 19 would create great ambiguity and consequently would seem to give rise to the risk of subsequent difficulties.

Article 19. Subject to the opinion of the Financial Commission within whose sphere lies the consideration of the proposed addition, it seems that the presence of the provisions already figuring in articles 8 and 19 render the insertion of new paragraph in question unnecessary.
Article 20. The addition of the word “recognised” seems justifiable and the text has been modified accordingly.
